slug: 2026-06-11 Can Africa supply it's own digital infrastructure

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers register says US-controlled operators, led by Digital Realty's Teraco and iColo, run operational carrier-neutral facilities concentrated in South Africa, Nigeria and Kenya, and that Teraco's South African campuses are the deepest on the continent by capacity; no date given, article date used.
The article says Cassava, as an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, has had 3,000 GPUs deployed in South Africa since mid-2025, offering AI-as-a-service; facility not named.
facts.system: Cassava AI GPU cloud, South Africa
